questions.q: A cube of side 5 cm is painted on all faces and cut into 1 cm cubes. How many small cubes have exactly one face painted?
questions.explanation: A small cube has exactly one painted face only when it lies inside a face and not on an edge. On each face, the usable interior grid is (5-2) x (5-2) = 3 x 3 = 9 cubes. There are 6 faces, so the total is 6 x 9 = 54.

questions.q: A cylinder has its radius doubled and its height reduced to one-fourth. Which statement correctly describes both its volume and curved surface area?
options: A) Volume doubles and curved surface area is unchanged
B) Volume is unchanged and curved surface area is halved
C) Volume is halved and curved surface area is unchanged
D) Volume is unchanged and curved surface area doubles
questions.answer: B) Volume is unchanged and curved surface area is halved
questions.explanation: Cylinder volume is proportional to r^2h. Doubling r multiplies r^2 by 4, while making h one-fourth multiplies by 1/4, so the volume factor is 1. Curved surface area is proportional to rh, so its factor is 2 x 1/4 = 1/2, meaning it is halved.

questions.q: The areas of three coterminous faces of a cuboid are 6 cm2, 15 cm2 and 10 cm2. What is the volume of the cuboid?
questions.explanation: Let the edge lengths be a, b and c, so ab = 6, bc = 15 and ca = 10. Multiplying the three equations gives (abc)^2 = 6 x 15 x 10 = 900. Therefore abc = sqrt(900) = 30 cm3, which is the cuboid volume.

questions.q: Metal cubes with edges 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm are melted to form one cube. What is the edge of the new cube?
questions.explanation: The total metal volume is conserved when the cubes are melted. Their volumes are 6^3 = 216, 8^3 = 512 and 10^3 = 1000, for a total of 1728 cm3. Since 1728 = 12^3, the new cube has edge 12 cm.
